newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran arrest pickpocket girl, disguised as a boy.
newsitem.headline: Iran arrest pickpocket girl, disguised as a boy.

text.p: Iranian police have arrested a teen-age girl who disguised herself as a boy on charges of theft, a newspaper said on Tuesday.
The 16-year-old girl, identified as Shirin, "quickly changed into a boy's outfit after each crime and hence got away with it by fooling everybody," Kar Va Kargar reported.
She was pick-pocketing and shop-lifting in Isfahan, 500 km (300 miles) south of Tehran and none of the "criminals" who worked with her knew that "he was a girl", it added.
"She confessed that she needed to appear like a boy to protect herself since she spent most of the nights in parks and streets among homeless male vagabonds," said the daily, quoting police sources.
The girl, who named herself Dariush, a male name, told the police she left her home five years ago after her mother separated from her father who was a drug addict.
